Only tune 0 is ever started ($9D6E)

a voice's pattern has ended: plays it again while its repeat count lasts ($731E), else reads the next pattern number from the order list

the frame's work, voice by voice from the last the tune plays (the LDX's operand, $6CB4) down to voice 0. On a tick ($733B at 0) a voice whose note has run out ($732D) reads its next event; between ticks it only runs its programs ($6F6F). On a tick a voice's gate closes ($7312 = $FE) when its gate-off count ($7315) runs out, unless the instrument keeps it open to the note's end

a new instrument, kept as eight times its number ($72EB). On the voice that owns the filter it also starts the instrument's filter program ($6E77), with its filter type from $71FA, or turns the filter's program off
